subject: [PATCH v4 21/21] Documentation: iomap: update docs to reflect iomap_iter_next model

reviews.author: Darrick Wong
reviews.summary: Reviewer Darrick Wong noted that the documentation update is correct and matches the new iomap_iter_next() callback model, but did not provide any specific technical feedback or suggestions.
reviews.raw_body:
Looks good to me,
Reviewed-by: "Darrick J. Wong" <djwong@kernel.org>

2026-07-27.patch_summary: This patch updates the iomap documentation to reflect a change in how filesystems interact with the iomap API. Specifically, it removes the need for separate iomap_begin and iomap_end callbacks, instead using a single iomap_iter_next callback that finishes the previous mapping and produces the next one. The patch also updates various sections of the documentation to match this new model, making it easier for filesystem developers to understand how to use the iomap API correctly.
